gap.definition: records with empty mixinTargets but non-empty mixinConfigs
gap.evidenceLevel: modcrawl evidence is primary (raw JSON array read from disk: 2 entries); naming-side emptiness is metadata only (candidates.jsonl) because the jar's mixins.entitycrosshair.json was not opened - this lane has no shell and cannot unzip
gap.detail: jar EntityCrosshair-2.0.0-26.2+_fabric.jar, modId entitycrosshair, mixinConfigs ["mixins.entitycrosshair.json"], mixinTargets []. modcrawl raw gives 2 entries: tomeko/entitycrosshair/mixins/HudMixin.class -> net/minecraft/client/gui/Hud and tomeko/entitycrosshair/mixins/MainMixin.class -> net/minecraft/client/main/Main. Because modcrawl supplies targets, no reason bucket was assigned.

notes: Record count: 36 lines in candidates.jsonl; 36 rows (plus header) in invocations.tsv; 36 files in raw/. Every row has exit_code 0.

namingTargets = number of elements in candidates.mixinTargets for that record. Every count was checked with an exact-length regex match ("mixinTargets":\[("[^"]*",){N-1}"[^"]*"\]) against candidates.jsonl, so no length is estimated.

modcrawlTargets = number of entries in the raw JSON array. The raw files are pretty-printed with 4 lines per entry, so the closing "]" line is 4N+2; entry counts were taken from the grep-reported closing-bracket line numbers and cross-checked by reading files end to end or by tail (AutoEat 1 entry/line 6, BiomesOPlenty 3/14, EntityCrosshair 2/10, iris 175/702).
Every one of the 30 entry files closes on a line congruent to 2 mod 4, consistent with the uniform 4-line entry shape; the other 6 files are exactly "[]" on line 1.

NEITHER bucket = c2me, oneconfigbootstrap, simpleguiapi, fzzy_config. Exactly 4 records in candidates.jsonl have "mixinConfigs":[] and they are the same 4 records, so the whole NEITHER bucket has no declared mixin config at this level.

NAMING_ONLY bucket = crash_assistant (3 naming targets, 2 declared configs) and sodium (74 naming targets, 2 declared configs); modcrawl returned an empty array for both. Not classified further in this lane.

gap = 1 record (entitycrosshair) as expected for this batch; the 5 records with empty mixinTargets are entitycrosshair, oneconfigbootstrap, simpleguiapi, c2me, fzzy_config, and only entitycrosshair has a non-empty mixinConfigs.

Unique modIds are reported per bucket only and are never summed across buckets; the BOTH record count (29) exceeds its unique modId count (28) because bclib appears twice (fabric bclib-26.201.5.jar and neoforge bclib-26.2.1.jar).

sha256 pairing between candidates.jsonl and invocations.tsv was spot-checked on 3 of 36 rows (AutoEat, EntityCrosshair, Time & Weather Changer) and matches case-insensitively; the full 36-row comparison was not performed.
Read-only: no jar was unpacked, no download, no modcrawl execution in this lane. Config file contents inside jars were not read, so nothing here is evidence about what those configs enumerate.
